subject: CLASS clause
notes: docs/CONFORMANCE.md §5 row A.4.14 (VALIDATE — Not claimed) + §4 item 3. Licence: Annex A.4.1 and its second sentence. OWNER DECISION kb/Work PB375, 2026-09-02 — the CLASS clause is DECLINED WITH VALIDATE. This rule is the clause's own statement of that confinement: "The CLASS clause takes effect during the content validation stage of the execution of a VALIDATE statement. The CLASS clause is ignored during the execution of any statement other than a VALIDATE statement." With no VALIDATE statement implemented there is no stage for it to take effect in, and the clause is refused by name (COBOL1708) rather than accepted and ignored.
